contractCases.expected: Root accepts scalar or array value/defaultValue, min0/max100, step1, largeStep10, orientation horizontal|vertical, disabled/name/form, minStepsBetweenValues and thumbCollisionBehavior push|swap|none. Wrapper thumbAlignment defaults edge but {...props} can override it. onValueChange has cancellable ChangeEventDetails with reason and activeThumbIndex; onValueCommitted has generic CommitEventDetails and only reports a changed, uncanceled commit. Source quantizes/clamps pointer/keyboard changes and enforces range collision policy. IMPORTANT wrapper quirk: thumb count is array value length, else array defaultValue length, else2; scalar props still create two Thumb instances. This reference explicitly uses value={[40]} for one thumb and arrays for ranges. Wrapper does not expose per-thumb naming/index props; Root aria-labelledby is propagated through primitive context to its internal range inputs.

The actual focusable controls are native input type=range nested inside thumb divs. Arrow keys step, PageUp/PageDown and Shift+arrows use largeStep, Home/End choose limits; horizontal direction respects RTL, vertical Up increases. Disabled inputs leave Tab order. Pointer drag/track press and keyboard changes have distinct change/commit lifecycle; Escape does not restore an earlier committed value. Range thumbs retain DOM order with collision policy owned by the primitive. This reference provides finite min<max and positive step, a shared explicit label and described units.
Candidate callback preserves exact source details; canceled request or controlled props do not autonomously change public value.
